faq_heading: Homes near Wix-Brown Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Wix-Brown Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Wix-Brown Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Wix-Brown Elementary. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Wix-Brown Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Vanguard (3.0 km north), Peterson Road Elementary (4.5 km north) and Aldergrove Christian Academy (5.0 km east).

Wix-Brown Elementary is an elementary school in Langley (Langley School District), at 23851 24 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Wix-Brown Elementary in the listing.
How the Wix-Brown Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Wix-Brown Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit some distance away. Ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 5 km of Wix-Brown Elementary

4 schools in the provincial school list sit within 5 km of Wix-Brown Elementary in a straight line (2 elementary, 1 secondary, 1 other; 2 independent). The closest is Vanguard, 3.0 km away, and the farthest on this list is Langley Christian School, 5.0 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Peterson Road Elementary (4.5 km); the nearest independent school is Aldergrove Christian Academy (5.0 km). Other elementary schools close by: Peterson Road Elementary (4.5 km north), Aldergrove Christian Academy (5.0 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Peterson Road Elementary, 4.5 km north of Wix-Brown Elementary.
